business_problem: industrial staffing operations were slowed by fragmented labor data, manual vetting, paper timesheets, and poor overnight visibility into shift coverage and warehouse conditions.
solution_summary: Traba uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: industrial staffing operations were slowed by fragmented labor data, manual vetting, paper timesheets, and poor overnight visibility into shift coverage and warehouse conditions. Gemini Flash answers hiring and worker questions in under a second and handles complex, high-frequency interactions across the staffing workflow, serving as the serving layer. Gemini Flash-Lite keeps large volumes of hiring and operational processing affordable while supporting more than 50 AI use cases, serving as the compute layer. Cloud Run executes Neo’s AI tasks on demand for bigger operational automations, serving as the serving layer. Google Kubernetes Engine scales Traba’s core software as demand grows across industrial customers, serving as the orchestration layer. BigQuery acts as the central hub for spreadsheets, business records, operational logs, and HR databases so Gemini can reason over one consistent dataset, serving as the storage layer.
